mapper.insert: insert into edu_classroom (classroom_code, classroom_name, floor, capacity, facilities, status, create_time) values(#{classroomCode}, #{classroomName}, #{floor}, #{capacity}, #{facilities}, #{status}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update edu_classroom set classroom_code = #{classroomCode}, classroom_name = #{classroomName}, floor = #{floor}, capacity = #{capacity}, facilities = #{facilities}, status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
